data.name: Elaijun
data.gender_notes: Elaijun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elaijun is derived from the Arabic words 'Al-Ayyan' meaning 'The God's Light'. It is a name that signifies divine guidance and spiritual enlightenment. The name Elaijun carries the meaning “God's Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Elaijun usually hope their child will grow to embody god's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Elaijun is a name that carries deep spiritual significance, representing a connection to the divine and a journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Elaijun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elaijun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: الایجن

in_hindi.name: एलایجन
